allow:
Bash(mkdir -p "$TEMP/inh/e" && cd "$TEMP/inh/e" && rm -rf ./*
t\(\) { name=$1; shift; mkdir -p $name; printf '%s\\n' "$@" > $name/X.java; echo "--- $name"; \(cd $name && javac X.java 2>&1 | grep -v "^\\s*\\^" | grep -v "^[0-9]* error" | sed 's/^X.java:[0-9]*: //' | head -4\); }
t covar 'class A {} class B extends A {} class P { A get\(\) { return null; } } class X extends P { B get\(\) { return null; } }'
t primret 'class P { int f\(\) { return 0; } } class X extends P { long f\(\) { return 0; } }'
t broader 'import java.io.*; class P { void f\(\) throws IOException {} } class X extends P { void f\(\) throws Exception {} }'
t newchecked 'class P { void f\(\) {} } class X extends P { void f\(\) throws Exception {} }'
t unchecked 'class P { void f\(\) {} } class X extends P { void f\(\) throws RuntimeException {} }'
t fewer 'import java.io.*; class P { void f\(\) throws IOException {} } class X extends P { void f\(\) throws FileNotFoundException {} }'
t finalm 'class P { final void f\(\) {} } class X extends P { void f\(\) {} }'
t finalc 'final class P {} class X extends P {}'
t statichides 'class P { void f\(\) {} } class X extends P { static void f\(\) {} }'
t instovstatic 'class P { static void f\(\) {} } class X extends P { void f\(\) {} }'
t overridetypo 'class X { @Override public String tostring\(\) { return ""; } }'
t overstatic 'class P { static void f\(\) {} } class X extends P { @Override static void f\(\) {} }'
t overprivate 'class P { private void f\(\) {} } class X extends P { @Override void f\(\) {} }'
t cyclic 'class X extends Y {} class Y extends X {}'
t multi 'class A {} class B {} class X extends A, B {}'
t supersuper 'class A { void f\(\) {} } class B extends A { void f\(\) {} } class X extends B { void f\(\) { super.super.f\(\); } }'
t superstatic 'class A { void f\(\) {} } class X extends A { static void g\(\) { super.f\(\); } }'
t noarg 'class P { P\(int x\) {} } class X extends P { X\(\) { } }'
t noargdefault 'class P { P\(int x\) {} } class X extends P { }'
t superfirst 'class P {} class X extends P { X\(\) { int a = 1; super\(\); } }'
t thisandsuper 'class P {} class X extends P { X\(\) { this\(1\); super\(\); } X\(int a\) {} }'
t superfield 'class P { P\(int x\) {} } class X extends P { int v = 3; X\(\) { super\(v\); } }'
t supermethod 'class P { P\(int x\) {} } class X extends P { X\(\) { super\(calc\(\)\); } int calc\(\) { return 1; } }'
t superstaticok 'class P { P\(int x\) {} } class X extends P { X\(\) { super\(calc\(\)\); } static int calc\(\) { return 1; } }'
t implorder 'interface I {} class P {} class X implements I extends P {}'
t extobj 'class X extends Object {}'
t ctorinherit 'class P { P\(int x\) {} } class X extends P { X\(\) { super\(1\); } static void m\(\) { new X\(5\); } }'
t widen 'class P { protected void f\(\) {} } class X extends P { public void f\(\) {} }'
t fieldnotover 'class P { int x; } class X extends P { @Override int x; }')

hooks.command: obsidian.com quartz-syncer:mark path="Public/**" state=publish && obsidian.com quartz-syncer:publish
